errors.message: Acceptance criterion 'gate-out reports zero format errors and zero auto-repaired fields' is unverifiable as written (task 996 Phase 3 trace): agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/command-gate-out.sh (134 lines) has no counter, aggregate, or exit-code surface for auto-repairs -- its only related line is a comment. The actual repair path is command-gate-out.sh -> skill_validate_task_artifacts (skill-base.sh) -> validate-artifact.sh "$f" "$type" --fix 2>/dev/null. validate-artifact.sh emits a terminal '[FIXED] $fixes field(s) auto-repaired, $errors error(s), $warnings warning(s) remaining' line and exits 2, but skill_validate_task_artifacts discards stderr, collapses every non-zero exit into one generic non-blocking WARNING with no numeric detail, and always returns 0 -- so command-gate-out.sh sees no signal at all. There is no 'gate-out reports' surface to assert or refute 'zero auto-repaired fields' against. Secondary hazard: --fix mutates the artifact in place, so a repair both happens and goes uncounted.

recovery.suggested_action: Add a repair counter/aggregate to skill_validate_task_artifacts in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/skill-base.sh that captures validate-artifact.sh's [FIXED] N count per file, sums it across the directory sweep, and surfaces the total (stdout line and/or exit-code signal) from command-gate-out.sh; alternatively amend the acceptance criterion to something checkable given current instrumentation.
